description: Source file implementing methods for torch::optim::Optimizer and related classes, including parameter group management, serialization, and optimizer state handling.

classes.name: OptimizerParamGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of parameters for an optimizer, with options and parameter list.

classes.name: OptimizerParamState
classes.description: Abstract class for storing optimizer-specific parameter state.

classes.name: OptimizerOptions
classes.description: Base class for optimizer options, including learning rate management.

classes.name: Optimizer
classes.description: Main optimizer class managing parameter groups, state, and serialization.

methods.name: has_options
methods.description: Checks if the parameter group has options set.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Returns a reference to the options of the parameter group.

methods.name: set_options
methods.description: Sets the options for the parameter group.

methods.name: params
methods.description: Returns the list of parameters in the group.

methods.description: Clones the optimizer parameter state or options; not implemented here.

methods.description: Serializes the state or options; not implemented here.

methods.name: add_param_group
